claim: Can anyone who has used HenryMeds share their experience?
summary: Thumbing through other links on the Henry's page, shows a great number of white-coated young ladies (no title given - only Peacock is referred to as Dr.). I'm as disappointed as any of you who were hoping to find Mounjaro at half price, but unless you think doctors are superfluous in prescribing, I can't trust this outfit.
